test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 21 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Gulzar was awarded the 66th Filmfare Award for ‘Best Lyrics’ for the film ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhapaak.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gulzar was awarded the 66th Filmfare Award for ‘Best Lyrics’ for the film Chhapaak.**
 
• Chhapaak is a 2020 Indian Hindi-language drama film directed by Meghna Gulzar and produced by Deepika Padukone and Meghna Gulzar in collaboration with Fox Star Studios.
 
• Deepika Padukone played the role of Lakshmi Agarwal in this film.
 
• **Meghna Gulzar got the Film Fare Award for Best Director in 2019.**
 
• The Government of Rajasthan has made the film 'Chhapak' tax-free in the state based on the story Laxmi Agarwal (Acid Attack Survivor).
 
• As per the order issued by the Finance Department on January 10, 2020, the film has been exempted from SGST. This order will be effective for six months.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The 66th National Film Awards** were announced on 9 August 2019.
 
• **Ayushman Khurana and Vicky Kaushal** jointly won the Best Actor Award for their performances in **'Andhadhun' and 'Uri: The Surgical Strike'.'**
 
• **'Badhai Ho'** bagged the award for Best Popular Film Providing Wholesome Entertainment.
 
• Hindi movie** 'Padman'** was declared Best Film on **Social Issues.**
